scanNote: 25 va 27-mashqlarda tushib qolgan sifatlar AUDIO orqali beriladi. Audio yo'q — javoblar rasmlar, 26-mashqdagi so'zlar ro'yxati va dialog mantiqidan chiqarilgan; har birining sababi whyUz da yozilgan. Grammatik qolip (What does he look like? / What is he like?) javob qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar bir xil o'rganiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the descriptions, then listen and fill in the missing words. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tavsiflarni o'rganing, so'ng tinglab tushib qolgan so'zlarni yozing. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada uch odam tasvirlanadi. Audio yo'q — sifatlar rasmlar va 26-mashqdagi so'zlar ro'yxatidan mantiqan tanlangan.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL — IKKI XIL JAVOB (bu mashqning MAG'ZI):

  What does he LOOK LIKE?  → TASHQI KO'RINISH
    He's good-looking with short fair hair and green eyes.

  What IS he LIKE?         → XARAKTER
    He's lazy.

Farq faqat 'look' so'zida! Uni tushirib qoldirsangiz,
savol butunlay boshqa ma'no oladi.

KARTOCHKALAR:
  Philip     — Appearance: 1) ... , short fair hair, green eyes
               Character: 2) ...
  Miss Adams — Appearance: 3) ... , long blonde hair, blue eyes
               Character: 4) ...
  Jean       — Appearance: 5) ... , short brown hair, brown eyes
               Character: 6) ...

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  He's/She's + KO'RINISH sifati + WITH + soch + and + ko'z.
  He's/She's + XARAKTER sifati.

items.question: What does Philip look like?
items.answer: He's good-looking with short fair hair and green eyes.

items.question: What does Miss Adams look like?
items.answer: She's gorgeous with long blonde hair and blue eyes.
items.whyUz: Rasmda yosh, uzun sariq sochli, ko'zga tashlanadigan ayol. 26-mashq ro'yxatidagi ko'rinish sifatlaridan 'gorgeous' unga mos.

items.question: What is she like?
items.whyUz: 26-mashq ro'yxatidagi xarakter sifatlaridan biri. Rasmdagi qat'iy, mag'rur qarash shunga ishora qiladi.

items.question: What does Jean look like?
items.answer: She's lovely with short brown hair and brown eyes.
items.whyUz: Rasmda ko'zoynakli, iliq tabassumli ayol. 'lovely' — yoqimli ko'rinish uchun.

items.question: What is she like?
items.whyUz: 26-mashq ro'yxatidan. Rasmdagi ochiq tabassum mehribonlikni bildiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu ikki savolni chalkashtirish — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.
Farqni mahkam o'rnashtirish uchun mashq.

items.whyUz: 'look like' — ko'rinish. Javob: tall, slim, fair hair...
'be like' — xarakter. Javob: kind, lazy, clever...

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoada ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap 1 ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 4 ning 19 ta kalit so'zi. Har biri bilan ma'noli gap tuzing.

RO'YXAT:
  family, live, lazy, city centre, clever, parents, camping,
  husband, rude, aunt, uncle, cousin, niece, bossy, lovely,
  good-looking, patient, kind, gorgeous

QOIDA: gap MA'NOLI va GRAMMATIK to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
Unit 4 grammatikasini ishlatsangiz — yanada yaxshi:
  Present Simple (-s 3-shaxsda)
  egalik ('s va s')
  egalik sifatlari (my, his, her, their)

modelSentences.sentence: There are five people in my family.
My brother is a bit lazy.
We live twenty minutes from the city centre.
modelSentences.uz: Biz shahar markazidan yigirma daqiqa masofada yashaymiz.

modelSentences.sentence: He is sometimes rude to his sister.
modelSentences.uz: U ba'zan singlisiga qo'pol muomala qiladi.

modelSentences.sentence: My aunt works in a hospital.
My uncle is my father's brother.
She's clever but she's a bit bossy.
She has got lovely green eyes.
My father is a very kind person.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue, then listen and fill in the missing adjectives. Which girl in the picture is Steve's sister? Listen again and follow the dialogue. Then, in pairs, act it out.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, tushib qolgan sifatlarni qo'ying. Rasmdagi qaysi qiz Stivning singlisi?
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada sifatlar aytiladi. Audio yo'q — sifatlar dialogning mantiqi va rasmdan chiqarilgan. Mashqning asosiy maqsadi — ODAMNI KO'RSATIB TANISHTIRISH iboralari.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT: ikki o'g'il (B va S = Steve) bog'da o'tirishibdi.
B bir qizni yoqtirib qoladi va uni Stivga ko'rsatmoqchi.
Oxirida ma'lum bo'ladi: u qiz — Stivning SINGLISI!

ODAMNI KO'RSATISH IBORALARI (bu mashqning asosiy maqsadi):
  Which girl?              — Qaysi qiz?
  That girl.               — Ana u qiz.
  The one over there.      — Anavi yerdagisi.
  ... with the ... hair    — ... sochli
  She's on the bench.      — U skameykada.
  Do you mean the girl in the dark T-shirt?
                           — Qora futbolkadagi qizni aytyapsanmi?
  Not her — the one next to her.
                           — U emas — uning yonidagisi.

'THE ONE' — takroriy otni almashtiradi:
  the one over there = the girl over there
  the one next to her = the girl next to her

'Do you mean ...?' — 'Sen ...ni aytyapsanmi?' — aniqlashtirish.
'Isn't she ...?' — 'U ... emasmi?' — rozilik kutib so'rash.
'not bad' — 'yomon emas' — kamtarona maqtov.
'actually' — 'aslida' — kutilmagan ma'lumot oldidan.

lines.textEn: Wow! Look at that girl, Steve!
lines.uz: Voy! Ana u qizga qara, Stiv!

lines.whyUz: B qizni yoqtirib qolgan — ko'rinish sifati kerak. 'pretty' (chiroyli) qizlar uchun eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'z.

lines.textEn: The one over there, with the 2) ____ hair.
lines.whyUz: Keyin S 'the girl in the dark T-shirt' ni so'raydi va B 'yo'q' deydi — demak bu qiz undan FARQ qiladi. Rasmda qora sochli qizning yonida uzun sariq sochli qiz turibdi.

lines.textEn: Yes you can! She's on the bench.
Do you mean the girl in the dark T-shirt?
No! Not her — the one next to her.
Oh, I can see her now.

lines.hintUz: Yana kuchliroq ko'rinish sifati — B rozilik kutyapti
lines.whyUz: 'Isn't she ...?' — rozilik kutib so'rash. B qizni yana bir bor maqtayapti, shuning uchun 'pretty' dan kuchliroq so'z.

lines.textEn: Mmm, not bad. She's very 4) ____ , too.
lines.hintUz: Bu safar KO'RINISH emas — XARAKTER sifati
lines.whyUz: 'too' (ham) — yangi xususiyat qo'shilyapti. Stiv qizni TANIYDI (u singlisi), shuning uchun uning XARAKTERINI biladi.

lines.textEn: Yes, I do actually. She's my sister.
lines.uz: Ha, aslida taniyman. U mening singlim.

exercises.instructionEn: Which girl in the picture is Steve's sister?
exercises.explanationUz:
Dialogdan uchta belgini yig'ing:
  1) u skameykada (on the bench)
  2) uning sochi uzun va sariq
  3) u qora futbolkadagi qizning YONIDA

items.answer: The girl with long fair hair, next to the girl in the dark T-shirt.
items.whyUz: Dialogda: 'the one over there, with the long fair hair', 'She's on the bench', 'Not her — the one next to her'.

exercises.instructionEn: Learn the phrases for identifying people.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu iboralar kundalik nutqda juda ko'p kerak bo'ladi —
olomon ichida kimnidir ko'rsatish uchun.

items.whyUz: Kutilmagan ma'lumot oldidan. 'aktualnyy' EMAS — bu soxta do'st so'z!

exercises.instructionEn: Use the letter in Ex. 4 as a model and the plan below to write a letter to your pen-friend.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi xatni namuna, quyidagi rejani esa qo'llanma sifatida olib, qalamkash do'stingizga xat yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA (Plan):

  Dear + (qalamkash do'stingizning ismi),

  INTRODUCTION (kirish)
  Para 1: kim ekaningiz, necha yoshda, kasbingiz,
          qayerda yashaysiz va qanday ko'rinasiz

  MAIN BODY (asosiy qism)
  Para 2: oilangiz (a'zolari, yoshi, kasbi) va uyingiz
  Para 3: nima qilishni yoqtirasiz / yoqtirmaysiz

  CONCLUSION (yakun)
  Para 4: do'stingizdan tez javob yozishni so'rang

  Best wishes,
  (ismingiz)

BU REJA — 26-betdagi Tonining xati bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilma.
Demak Tonining xatini namuna qilib olsangiz bo'ladi.

HAR BIR XATBOSHI YANGI QATORDAN va biroz ichkaridan boshlanadi.

structure.modelEn: I'm Aziz Karimov and I'm fourteen years old.
I'm a student and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
There are five of us in our family; my parents, Rustam and Nilufar, my sister, Malika, aged twelve, my brother, Sardor, aged eight, and of course, me.
My father is an engineer. He works at a local factory and my mother is a doctor in a hospital.
We live in a big house about fifteen minutes from the city centre.
In my free time, I love playing football and listening to music.
I also like reading and going to the cinema.
I don't like watching TV, though.
Well, that's all about me. Write back soon and tell me about yourself.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkala maqol ham BITTA fikrni aytadi:
bola ota-onasiga o'xshaydi.

Birinchisi — Unit 4 ning SARLAVHASI.
Shuning uchun butun unit oila haqida.

sentences.en: Like father, like son. / Like mother, like daughter.
sentences.uz: Ota qanday bo'lsa, o'g'il ham shunday. / Ona qanday bo'lsa, qiz ham shunday.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: bola ota-onasining xulqi va odatlarini takrorlaydi.

TUZILISHI juda qisqa — fe'l YO'Q:
  To'liq shakli: 'As the father is, so is the son.'
  Maqolda esa faqat 'Like ... , like ...' qoldirilgan.

'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS — 'kabi, o'xshash' degani.

Bu maqol ham ijobiy, ham salbiy ma'noda ishlatiladi:
  otasi ham shifokor, o'g'li ham → maqtov
  otasi ham kech qoladi, o'g'li ham → tanbeh

sentences.en: The apple never falls far from the tree.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: bola oilasiga o'xshaydi — undan uzoqlashmaydi.

Bu maqol O'ZBEKCHADA HAM AYNAN BOR:
  'Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.'
So'zma-so'z bir xil — chunki tabiat kuzatuvi hamma xalqda bir xil.

GRAMMATIKA: 'never' — inkor so'zi. U bilan ikkinchi inkor
qo'shilmaydi:
  ✅ The apple NEVER falls.
  ❌ The apple never doesn't fall.

Va 'falls' — 3-shaxs birlik -s (Unit 4 grammatikasi).

groups.explanationUz: Bir xil otni takrorlamaslik uchun 'the one' (birlik) yoki 'the ones' (ko'plik) ishlatiladi.
Kuchsizdan kuchligacha tartib. Kuchli sifatlar oldiga 'very' qo'yilmaydi.
Har qanday xat va inshoda shu uchta qism bo'ladi.
Rus/o'zbek tilidagi o'xshash so'zga tayanib xato qilinadigan so'zlar.

patterns.formula: What does + ega + look like? — He's/She's + sifat + WITH + soch va ko'z.
patterns.exampleEn: What does Philip look like? — He's good-looking with short fair hair and green eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: Filip qanday ko'rinadi? — U kelishgan, sochi kalta va sariq, ko'zlari yashil.

patterns.formula: What is + ega + like? — He's/She's + xarakter sifati.
patterns.exampleEn: What is he like? — He's lazy.
patterns.explanationUz: XARAKTER savoli. 'look' YO'Q. 'do/does' ham kerak emas — 'be' fe'li.

patterns.formula: The one + predlog + joy / with the + soch.
patterns.exampleEn: The one over there, with the long fair hair. Not her — the one next to her.
patterns.exampleUz: Anavi yerdagisi, uzun sariq sochlisi. U emas — uning yonidagisi.
patterns.explanationUz: Olomon ichida odamni ko'rsatish. 'the one' otni almashtiradi.

patterns.formula: Do you mean + ot? — No! Not her/him — the one ...
patterns.exampleEn: Do you mean the girl in the dark T-shirt? — No! Not her — the one next to her.
patterns.exampleUz: Qora futbolkadagi qizni aytyapsanmi? — Yo'q! U emas — uning yonidagisi.
patterns.explanationUz: Aniqlashtirish va tuzatish. 'Not her' — obyekt olmoshi (Unit 4).

patterns.formula: Isn't she/he + sifat? — Mmm, not bad.
patterns.exampleEn: Isn't she beautiful? — Mmm, not bad.
patterns.exampleUz: U go'zal emasmi? — Hmm, yomon emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
Inkor savol rozilik kutib so'raladi.
'not bad' — kamtarona javob, to'liq rozi bo'lmaslik.

patterns.exampleEn: Do you know her? — Yes, I do actually. She's my sister.
patterns.exampleUz: Uni tanaysanmi? — Ha, aslida taniyman. U mening singlim.
patterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javob (Yes, I do) + 'actually' kutilmagan ma'lumot oldidan.
